title: Young
lyrics:
[00:22.98]Another day goes by
[00:29.72]And where was I?
[00:35.32]Didn't think I'd still be here
[00:41.31]Just to make things clear
[00:48.50]What's the use?
[00:51.55]I'm not talking sense
[00:54.63]Call it a ruse
[00:57.95]On myself
[01:02.44]I wanted to go
[01:08.34]I wanted to say
[01:14.04]All things come to pass with time
[01:19.95]But I want everything now to be all mine
[01:47.08]You think it's all over
[01:52.93]Get up and try again
[01:58.95]You've got to act your age, darling
[02:04.93]Before you fall back in
[02:12.44]What's the use?
[02:15.51]I'm not talking sense
[02:18.57]Call it a ruse
[02:21.98]On myself
[02:26.46]I wanted to go
[02:32.37]I wanted to say
[02:37.95]All things come to pass with time
[02:44.08]But I want everything now to be all mine
